Looked up for Sarah: DC02 is $239.99, 105 MH/s at ~25 watts — about $2.88 a month at 16¢. Doge block odds roughly 1 in 21,000 a day.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Over twelve cents, okay, so the power bill matters, and I'll run the Hammer Miner DC02 honestly at your rate. Roughly what do you pay, fifteen, twenty? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
At sixteen cents, the DC02 costs about two eighty-eight a month in power. That's less than a coffee. Is this your first miner? (The call ended. 1 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
